pages.text: $(l)Worn$(): repairing and combining enchantments at an anvil costs $(l)30%%$() less experience. Anything already "Too Expensive!" still is.$(br2)$(l)Offered$(): anvils within $(l)48 blocks$() of the temple never get damaged.
Kept in the vault at the back of a Cyclops cave. Everyone gets it once; opening the vault again gives nothing.

Hephaestus is the lame god of the forge. In Book 18 of the $(o)Iliad$() he makes Achilles a new shield: he sets the great anvil on its block and takes up the hammer in one hand and the tongs in the other.
